benchmark_name: CIS Apple macOS 14 Sonoma & 15 Sequoia Benchmark

rules.title: Ensure 'Check for Software Updates' is Enabled
rules.description: Background software update checks ensure zero-day vulnerabilities and Rapid Security Responses are received promptly.
rules.remediation: Enable automatic updates via 'sudo softwareupdate --schedule on'.

rules.title: Ensure FileVault 2 Full Disk Encryption is Enabled
rules.description: FileVault secures the APFS startup container by encrypting all user data and system caches at rest.
rules.remediation: Enable FileVault in System Settings > Privacy & Security or run 'sudo fdesetup enable'.

rules.title: Ensure System Integrity Protection (SIP) is Enabled
rules.description: System Integrity Protection locks critical directories (/System, /usr, /bin) and disallows unauthorized dtrace/kext loading.
rules.remediation: Boot into Recovery Mode and run 'csrutil enable' in Terminal.

rules.title: Ensure Gatekeeper Assessments are Enabled
rules.description: Gatekeeper validates Developer ID code signatures and Apple notarization before binary execution.

rules.title: Ensure macOS Application Firewall is Enabled
rules.description: The application firewall monitors and blocks incoming connections to non-whitelisted sockets and daemons.

rules.title: Ensure Firewall Stealth Mode is Enabled
rules.description: Stealth mode prevents disclosure of host existence by dropping ICMP probes and TCP reset responses.

rules.title: Ensure Remote Login (SSH) is Disabled When Not in Use
rules.description: Running an open SSH daemon without strict key-only controls exposes the host to network brute-force attacks.
rules.remediation: Disable Remote Login via 'sudo systemsetup -setremotelogin off'.

rules.title: Ensure Screen Sharing / VNC Service is Disabled
rules.description: VNC listening sockets (TCP 5900) allow remote graphical access and can be intercepted if unencrypted.
rules.remediation: Turn off Screen Sharing in System Settings > General > Sharing.

rules.title: Ensure Remote Apple Events is Disabled
rules.description: Remote Apple Events enables network-wide execution of AppleScript and automation commands.
rules.remediation: Disable Remote Apple Events via 'sudo systemsetup -setremoteappleevents off'.

rules.title: Ensure Guest Account is Disabled
rules.description: The Guest account allows untrusted physical users to log into temporary local sessions.
rules.remediation: Disable Guest account in System Settings > Users & Groups.

rules.title: Ensure Root Account Direct Login is Disabled
rules.description: The root superuser account should remain disabled; administrative tasks should use sudo instead.

rules.title: Ensure OpenBSM Audit Configuration is Present
rules.description: Audit daemon configuration controls kernel-level security event logging and forensic trail retention.

rules.title: Ensure Secure Boot Policy is Enforced Without Unsafe Flags
rules.description: Boot arguments must not contain debug flags that turn off AMFI or code signature verification.
rules.remediation: Clear boot arguments using 'sudo nvram -d boot-args'.
